show.description: A rich and loving husband, Abhimanyu, builds his world around his beautiful wife Nandita. But Nandita betrays him, fakes her death, frames him in fraud, and runs away with a greedy lover. Left broken and left for dead, Abhimanyu rises again, reborn with power and determination. This is an unlike ever seen before story of revenge.
